description: Run a VTEX store from workflows: list and look up orders, start handling them, send invoices and tracking, and cancel them; add and change products and SKUs; set prices and stock; and keep customer profiles up to date. Start a workflow when an order is placed or reaches a status, when a customer signs up or changes, or when a Master Data record is added.

vtex_customer_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a customer profile is added or changed in the VTEX store, with the profile as it now is. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.document: Their document number, such as a tax ID
output.document_type: The kind of document, such as cpf
output.newsletter: True if they signed up for the newsletter

output.document_type: The kind of document, such as cpf

output.status: Its status as VTEX names it, such as ready-for-handling
output.status_label: Its status in words, such as Ready for handling
